description.value: The Bowen Island Visitor Information Centre occupies a picturesque heritage building known as the Boulevard Cottage, situated immediately off the Bowen Island ferry terminal — making it the natural first stop for day-trippers and touring cyclists arriving by ferry. Operated by Tourism Bowen Island, it offers maps, local guides, and trip-planning advice covering the island's cycling trails, outdoor activities, restaurants, and accommodations. A downloadable 2025 Visitor Map & Guide is available covering parks, trails, beaches, and ferry schedules.
